seed_audit: No overlap in 67 suite_manifest.json files at registration
control: Original five initial alphas, no Stage 3 cache, B20 selector
treatment: Replace target-local alpha with marginal_information_50; cache repeated exact float32 model-visible AgentNode inputs within each Stage 3 candidate solve; same B20 selector
marginal_formula: If positive Stage 0 leave-one-agent-out ensemble MSE gains exist, alpha_marginal=0.5*B+0.5*normalize(max(gain,0)); otherwise B fallback
cache_scope: Agent ID/model checkpoint and exact float32 shape+bytes, reset for each candidate solve; no cross-seed, cross-model, or cross-candidate cache
shared_controls: 2D target 0; fixed participant IDs [1,2,20]; box [-1,1] tolerance 1e-8; best_of custom_iterations 30; 20 Stage 0 blind labels; clean pooled evaluator; no pruning, dynamic alpha, or payment; baseline and cached replay use identical saved models and proposals
information_boundary: Pooled evaluator and synthetic truth not used to set alpha, solve Stage 3, select candidate, or make cache decisions; pooled score computed after candidate X exists
primary_quality: Paired pooled absolute target error E_treatment - E_control; negative favors treatment
analysis: 180 seeds, 10000 seed-paired bootstrap resamples with research_analysis default RNG, two-sided 95 percent CI; report all failures separately
success_gate: 180/180 valid feasible control and treatment deliveries with no additional failure
Paired mean pooled error difference 95 percent CI upper bound strictly below zero
Mean method-independent local-model API requests lower for cached marginal than original no-cache five
Mean method-independent local-model input samples lower for cached marginal than original no-cache five
method_cost_scope: For each method, candidate initialization and B20 selection requests plus its five Stage 3 solves; shared model training, qualification, proposals and evaluator preparation separately counted per seed; no monetary or latency claim
secondary_diagnostics: Pooled means/medians/Q1/Q3 and per-seed difference tail
Stage 3 and initialization requests and input samples separately
Cached X, selected method, solver, and pooled score equality with uncached same-alpha candidate
Truth only as diagnostic, pooled/truth conflicts, evaluator coverage
Qualification, candidate, and solver failures with consumed costs
no_tuning: No method, threshold, cache key, or seed replacement based on formal pooled results; implementation bugs require new version and affected rerun
